title: Texas Life & Health Exam
intro: Everything on the Texas General Lines - Life, Accident and Health exam (Pearson VUE outline effective Sept 1, 2026): 100 general questions and 30 Texas law questions, 70 to pass. Read each concept, then switch to Study to drill its flashcards on a spaced-repetition schedule. Study material, not legal or tax advice.

lifepolicies.title: Life policies & annuities
lifepolicies.scope: Whole, universal, variable, indexed and term life; annuities; joint and survivorship plans.

lifeprovisions.title: Life riders & provisions
lifeprovisions.scope: Riders, beneficiaries, premiums, loans, nonforfeiture, dividends, settlement options, exclusions.

underwriting.title: Application, underwriting & delivery
underwriting.scope: Applications, receipts, insurable interest, MIB and FCRA, risk classes, delivery, contract law.

retirement.title: Retirement, business uses & taxes
retirement.scope: Group life, qualified plans, needs analysis, key person and buy-sell, taxation, MECs.

healthpolicies.title: Health & disability policies
healthpolicies.scope: Disability income, AD&D, medical expense plans, HSAs, Medicare supplement, group and COBRA, LTC.

healthprovisions.title: Health provisions & renewability
healthprovisions.scope: Uniform provisions, cost-sharing clauses, riders, renewability.

socialother.title: Medicare, Medicaid & other concepts
socialother.scope: Medicare Parts A-D, Medicaid, Social Security disability, coordination of benefits, managed care.

txcommon.title: Texas law: rules for both lines
txcommon.scope: Commissioner, licensing, CE, unfair practices, agent duties, guaranty association.

txlife.title: Texas law: life insurance
txlife.scope: Advertising, policy provisions, group and credit life, replacement, nonforfeiture.

txhealth.title: Texas law: health & HMOs
txhealth.scope: Required provisions, Medicare supplement, LTC, small group, ACA, HMOs.
